overview_description.description:
Innoviti develops payments processing, credit distribution, and payments management software solutions. It offers uniPAY, a unified payment and card management system for retailers; quickEMI, a solution that provides consumers the option of paying for their purchases in installments on their credit cards; pgEMI, a solution that provides consumers the option of paying for their purchases in installments; and fastCollect, an automated collection technology for banks and retailers/online megastores. 

Innoviti serves markets, such as retail, mobile, lifestyle, entertainment, jewelry, education, cabs, holidays, hotels, restaurants, wellness, healthcare, online, and banks.

about_short_description.short_description: Innoviti develops payment processing, credit distribution, and payment management software solutions.

product.name: Omnium Payment Gateway
product.description: A payment gateway that enables merchants to accept credit/debit cards, EMI, and UPI payments with integrated bank-funded promotions and flexible settlement options.

product.name: Innoviti Link
product.description: A mobile app that allows merchants to create and send payment links via WhatsApp for instant collection of payments through cards, EMI, or UPI.

product.name: Unified Bill & Chargeslip (UBC)
product.description: A digital invoicing tool that combines the invoice and payment charge-slip into a single digital document sent via SMS or WhatsApp.

product.name: Innoviti Genie
product.description: A smart marketing application designed to help mobile retailers increase walk-ins, conversions, and profits through targeted promotions.

product.name: Universal Payment Collection App
product.description: A platform that consolidates multiple payment modes including UPI, cards, and EMI into a single interface for streamlined payment acceptance.
